cases.facts: On 1 June 2026, an existing RSA recipient belongs to a two-person household and is adjudicated subject to the obligations under L262-28. The departmental president is the competent decision maker. This is the first refusal to prepare the engagement contract; no prior or persistent sanction exists. A partial suspension of 50% for one month is proposed, not a suppression or radiation. The household and relevant facts stated here are exhaustive. No notification inviting observations was sent before the proposed decision. There is no legitimate reason for refusal.
cases.boundary: Proposed first suspension; fixed household, competent actor, duration and rate. Notification and legitimate reason contrasted; exercise of discretion is not stipulated.
probe: Whether the proposed partial suspension is legally available on these facts.
Whether the stated rate and duration are within the source limits.
Whether any authority or duty position relating to this suspension is source-supported.

cases.facts: On 1 June 2026, an existing RSA recipient belongs to a two-person household and is adjudicated subject to the obligations under L262-28. The departmental president is the competent decision maker. This is the first refusal to prepare the engagement contract; no prior or persistent sanction exists.
